cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get to the bottom of the dead office plant. Tell me what you saw it being watered with, and I'll run the checks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You poured your coffee into it. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we have a starting point. You can oversee the samples; I'll make the coffee exactly as it was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: With the six sugars you put in before you watered it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. You count them while I stir. Then we can label the mixture and work out what this plant couldn't tolerate; I want you satisfied we've checked it properly.

reason: Make A investigator confidence depend on B supervising/counting the exact incriminating recipe, while redirecting responsibility toward tolerance rather than admitting harmful watering.
